page.overview:
Who is Gundolpho Bolger?

Gundolpho Bolger was a hobbit of the Shire, and the patriarch of the Bolger family.

Born in the year TA 2731, Gundolpho at some point married Alfrida of the Yale, who bore him three children: Gundahar, Gundahad, and Rudolph. He died in TA 2830.
